predecessors.name: Principality of Vladimir-Suzdal (Grand Principality of Vladimir)
predecessors.text: the city of Nizhny Novgorod and its district, 'incorporated into the Vladimir-Suzdal Principality in 1264'

successors.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
successors.text: Nizhny Novgorod, 'incorporated into the Grand Principality of Moscow in 1392'

ledger.x: 1294 (Cliopatria's first year): Nizhny Novgorod appears as a polity of its own.
ledger.cpn: Principality of Vladimir-Suzdal (Grand Principality of Vladimir)

ledger.x: 1350: the seat of the Suzdal Principality moves from Gorodets to Nizhny Novgorod.
1392: Nizhny Novgorod is incorporated into Moscow.
1392: the principality ends in Moscow's hands; its land goes to the Grand Principality of Moscow.

certainty.note: The page gives a city and a principality's seat, not a boundary; the extent is approximate.
